subject.title: feat(openrouter): browse live models during setup

question: Should the OpenRouter setup picker intentionally augment its explicit browse view with the provider’s changing public model inventory, while retaining the static catalog when discovery is unavailable?
rationale: The patch adds a user-visible dynamic inventory source to setup rather than repairing a documented broken contract; source evidence supports the implementation shape but cannot establish product acceptance.

options.title: Accept live browse augmentation
options.body: Keep the provider-owned five-minute cached discovery path and static fallback, subject to inspectable runtime proof.

options.title: Keep static setup inventory
options.body: Decline dynamic discovery for setup and retain the existing manually maintained/configured OpenRouter picker rows.

recommendation.title: Accept live browse augmentation
recommendation.body: Keep the provider-owned five-minute cached discovery path and static fallback, subject to inspectable runtime proof.
